harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Updated bin/install-report for POSIX sh. It now handles destinations containing spaces, preserves both templates exactly, installs an executable launcher, fails correctly for unusable destinations, and is safe to rerun. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were retained. node1 successfully recovered from the mandatory reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced the Bash array with a POSIX-compatible loop.
Quoted all destination paths and added argument validation.
Verified template and launcher integrity using cmp and SHA-256.
Tested first installation, repeated installation, launcher execution, and an unpopulatable destination.
Restarted node1 once and repeated the complete verification after recovery.

evidence.requirement: Installer works under POSIX /bin/sh and supports destination paths containing spaces.
evidence.summary: BusyBox sh syntax passed and installation to a multi-level path containing spaces succeeded.

evidence.requirement: Both templates retain their exact contents and the launcher is executable.
evidence.summary: Source and installed SHA-256 hashes matched, cmp passed, the executable bit was present, and the launcher ran successfully.

evidence.requirement: Repeated installation is safe and an unpopulatable destination reports failure.
evidence.summary: A second installation succeeded without changes; a destination beneath a regular file emitted an error and exited with status 1 before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel are retained.
evidence.summary: Both pre- and post-restart evidence show Alpine Linux 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 88a53b68-be77-46bc-a92c-30c64160eaa0; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID changed to 758636d5-6b12-4282-a6f4-4bdafa0e4d66; OpenRC services, bundle hashes, installation behavior, data integrity, launcher execution, rerun safety, and failure handling all recovered successfully.
